name: Fragments of the Pylons
summary: Mordent Evenshade asks you to recover pylon fragments from the Magram and Gelkis villages in Shen'dralas. The pieces are needed for his work on the damaged pylons.

sections.title: Broken Pylons
sections.body: Mordent Evenshade believes centaur rampages damaged both pylons in Shen'dralas. He suspects the Magram and Gelkis carried the scattered shards back to their villages as trophies. You are asked to recover the fragments guarded there and bring them to him.

sections.title: The Crystals
sections.body: Mordent receives the fragments and says the crystals are more broken than he expected. He will keep them for now. His next step is to gather pliable mana, which can bind the pieces and let leyline power pass through them.

faq.q: Who asks for the pylon fragments?
faq.answer: Mordent Evenshade asks you to recover shards and fragments from the Magram and Gelkis villages and return them to him.
Mordent believes the Magram and Gelkis took the pylon fragments to their villages in Shen'dralas.
Mordent believes reckless centaur activity damaged both pylons.

faq.q: What does Mordent plan to do with the fragments?
faq.answer: Mordent plans to bind the broken pieces with pliable mana and use that mana as a conduit for the leylines.
